title: Wavelet Flow Matching for Multi-Scale Physics Emulation
abstract: arXiv:2605.16573v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Accurate emulation of multi-scale physical systems governed by PDEs demands models that remain stable over long autoregressive rollouts while preserving fine-scale structures. Deterministic emulators produce overly smoothed predictions, while generative approaches better capture details but are costly. Latent-space generative models have emerged as a compromise but with the additional cost of separately pre-trained autoencoders. We propose Wavelet Flow Matching (WFM), a generative emulator that overcomes current trade-offs between cost and skill by performing optimal-transport flow matching directly in the multi-scale wavelet space. Rather than learning a latent compression, WFM leverages the hierarchical structure of a U-Net to jointly predict the transport velocities of a prescribed, lossless wavelet representation. translated_title: 用于多尺度物理仿真的小波流匹配
translated_abstract: 对由偏微分方程（PDE）支配的多尺度物理系统进行精确仿真，要求模型在长时自回归滚动预测中保持稳定，同时保留细尺度结构。确定性仿真器会产生过度平滑的预测，而生成式方法虽能更好地捕捉细节但计算成本高昂。潜空间生成模型作为一种折中方案出现，但其代价是需要额外单独预训练的自编码器。我们提出小波流匹配（Wavelet Flow Matching, WFM），这是一种生成式仿真器，通过直接在多尺度小波空间中执行最优传输流匹配，克服了当前成本与性能之间的权衡。WFM 不学习潜在压缩，而是利用 U-Net 的层次结构，联合预测一个规定的无损小波表示的传输速度。在三个具有挑战性的混沌流体动力学系统上，WFM 实现了更优的谱相干性和具有竞争力的……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出小波流匹配（WFM），直接在多尺度小波空间中进行最优传输流匹配，无需预训练自编码器，在混沌流体仿真中以更低成本实现了更优的谱相干性与细节保持能力。
en_tdlr: Wavelet Flow Matching (WFM) performs optimal-transport flow matching directly in multi-scale wavelet space without pre-trained autoencoders, achieving superior spectral coherence and a better cost-skill trade-off for chaotic fluid dynamics emulation.
